title: Random Troll Commands
description: Adds troll commands to mess with your friends
body:
# RMD Commands Adds fun troll commands to prank your friends on a server. Type **`/rmd help`** in-game to see all commands. ## Commands on other players
/loadingscreen <player> **What it does** Stuck on the **"Loading terrain…"** screen. Looks like the world is still loading. **How to turn off** Run the command again on the same player. **After rejoin** Goes away when they leave the server.
/demoscreen <player> **What it does** Shows the demo screen on their screen and they can't close it (only operators can close it without problem). **How to turn off** Run the command again, or use `/demoscreen off `. **After rejoin** Stays on until you turn it off.
/credit <player> **What it does** Plays the **end credits** on their screen. **How long** Happens once when you run it. **Note** They can leave it the same way as on the normal end credits screen.
/resourcepack <player> <url> **What it does** Makes them download and use a **resource pack** from a link you send (must start with `http://` or `https://`). **How to turn off** Use `/resourcepack off`.
/fakedc <player> **What it does** Kicks them with a **fake error** message. Looks like their internet or the connection broke, not a normal server kick. **How long** Instant. Happens once when you run it.
/serverjoin <player> <host> **What it does** Sends them to **another server**. **Example** `play.example.com` or `play.example.com:25565`
/invsee <player> **What it does** Opens their **inventory** in a chest screen so you can look at and change their items. **How long** Only while that screen is open.
## Commands for yourself
/vanish or /v **What it does** Hide from other players. You can fly and you won't take damage. **How to turn off** Run `/vanish` or `/v` again. **After rejoin** Stays on until you turn it off.
/deathvanish **What it does** When you **die**, others see you dying and get the normal death message. But you switch into **vanish** and stay at that position. **Watch out** You still lose your items if **keepInventory** is off. **How to turn off** Run `/deathvanish` again before you die.
/fakeleave **What it does** Sends a fake **"left the game"** message in chat and hides you from the player list. **How to turn off** Use `/fakejoin`.
/fakejoin **What it does** Undoes `/fakeleave` and sends a fake **"joined the game"** message.
## In-game help
/rmd help Shows all commands in chat.
## Requirements Minecraft **26.1**, **Fabric**, and **Fabric API**.
